The documents don't mention Daniil Kvyat, so they can't confirm his teammates. The answer below comes from general knowledge, not the retrieved material.

Max Verstappen was Kvyat's teammate at Toro Rosso in 2015 and at Red Bull in 2016, and Verstappen went on to win the drivers' championship in 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024. Verstappen appears in documents [1] through [5] and [7], but only as a result in those races, not in connection with Kvyat.

ANSWER: Max Verstappen
